title: VisualizationManifest
description: The manifest file that defines a community visualization's metadata, resources, data requirements, and style configuration.

name.description: The display name of the visualization.

organization.description: The organization or developer that created the visualization.

description.description: A description of what the visualization does.

logoUrl.description: URL to the visualization's logo image.

devMode.description: Whether the visualization is in development mode. Development mode disables caching.

components.description: The list of visualization components defined in this manifest.
